psychological_meaning: Blizzard Blue evokes feelings of calmness, serenity, and clarity. It is reminiscent of winter landscapes, suggesting peace, tranquility, and a refreshing coolness. This color can also inspire creativity and introspection, promoting a sense of spaciousness and mental clarity.

real_world_examples.title: Glacier National Park

real_world_examples.title: Winter Sky
